tts_summary: Hey there, AJ! At seven months you're in that lively adolescent phase — puppies around this age typically push boundaries, finish big teething stages, and bloom in training readiness. Pugs are goofy, social, and a bit stubborn, but with a short muzzle AJ's more heat- and allergy-sensitive, and his powerful chewing and energy are totally normal. You know how he can zoom in the yard then flop for a nap? That's your day-to-day: lots of short training reps, high-energy bursts, and managing shedding and apartment life. The plan below focuses on steady nutrition, training treats, and calming/wipe essentials to support this stage. Check the recommendations below to get started.
